text.tspan: Illustrative 4 x 3 grid: right/down only; collect both endpoints
Green cells/arrows: one optimal route, total 1+0+1+1+1+1 = 5
Base dp[0,0]=1; dp[r,c] = grid + max(dp above, dp left)
↑ from above, ← from left; ties go up
